digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter — Cloud summary write and recovery
propositions: One Cloud summary write invocation must launch exactly one ACLI subprocess process with proper POSIX process-group and child cleanup.
Summary recovery must perform exactly one primary-store REST request with one-attempt/no-sleep policy, never retrying or using JQL.

All unrelated REST callers (_direct_rest_get siblings, PUT/POST helpers, paged GETs, and external get_issue_by_rest consumers) must retain the default three-attempt/2s-5s retry behavior when omitting the policy argument.
Permanent (auth/TLS/permission/invalid) and transient (network/429/retryable 5xx) outcomes must classify correctly and map to the shared budget contract without adapter-level replay.

Every terminal or exhausted outcome must emit exactly one redacted completion log with bounded fields (logical id, disposition, counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, message capped at 512 Unicode code points) and at most eight operation diagnostics entries, with total log size at most 1,024 Unicode code points.
